description: Event catalogue of logs/events.jsonl (design §8.4): every event_name, its level and its owner. o11y_door.api.event_report refuses names not listed here. `level` is the default; `levels` lists the allowed levels where the level varies.

o11y.agent.finding.description: a ledger finding written by a session

o11y.agent.incident.description: a ledger incident record written by a session; level follows the record's severity

o11y.analyzer.llm_failed.description: a model pass failed; its cursor did not advance

o11y.api.error.description: first occurrence of a fatal API error kind

o11y.campaign.stale.description: KernelForge campaign reported running with no state change beyond the threshold

o11y.compaction.done.description: a compaction in a fleet session

o11y.config.invalid.description: a config document is invalid; the last valid one stays in effect

o11y.files.removed_externally.description: files the fleet relies on were removed by someone else

o11y.incident.reported.description: an unplanned event found in history (model pass); level may be raised to ERROR

o11y.session.crashed.description: registry: record present, process dead or procStart mismatch

o11y.session.permission_wait.description: waiting on a permission prompt, sandbox or worker request beyond the threshold

o11y.source.schema_mismatch.description: a source file lacks a relied-upon field or has the wrong type

o11y.source.untrusted_path.description: an external data root lies below a directory others may rewrite (world-writable, not sticky); still read as display data, reported once per root

o11y.task.conclusion.description: a conclusion reached (model pass, or a ledger record written by a session)

o11y.task.service.description: a service started or stopped (model pass)

o11y.tokens.crossed.description: new-token total crossed one or more steps (session or fleet)
